"MAX-A-MILLION" has had no $1 million top prize claimed for close to two months. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything here about "MAX-A-MILLION" comes from official North Carolina lottery numbers, current through October 30.
985.headline: Good news: no big claims

988.body:
"Emerald 10's" has 221,221 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Emerald 10's" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
988.headline: What's actually left to win

990.body:
"LADY LUCK" is well into its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Every line of LADY LUCK's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
990.headline: How far along this game is

992.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "$2 MILLION VAULT", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is in the second half of its run, with one of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Every line of $2 MILLION VAULT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
992.headline: Tickets sold so far

993.body:
"$5,000 Triple Play" has had no $5,000 top prize claimed for five months. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Today's free summary of "$5,000 Triple Play" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
993.headline: Five months, no top prize claimed

994.body:
"$25,000 Triple Play" has one of four top prizes left and is well into its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Today's free summary of "$25,000 Triple Play" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
994.headline: How far along this game is

995.body:
"$200,000 Triple Play" has 176,693 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $5,000 prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything above about "$200,000 Triple Play" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
995.headline: A close look at the prizes

996.body:
The top prize count on "$1,000,000 Triple Play" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has four of five top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "$1,000,000 Triple Play" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
996.headline: Top prizes are still left
